wylie: gang gi phyir byang sems 'dis nang gi bag chags smin pa las gzugs sogs 'byung bar 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rigs pas sems la rang las rdzas gzhan gyi gzung ba med par de las don gzhan pa'i de 'dzin par byed pa ma mthong zhing, srid pa khams gsum po ni rnam par shes pa tsam mo zhes rab tu rtogs pas te nas
english: The bodhisattva utilizes reasoning—which we are about to explain—to understand how physical form and the like come into being through the ripening of deep seeds inside of themselves; which is to say, this logic allows them to understand how there are no objects of perception which are such that to be them is not to be the mind itself. They see no entities which act to hold to these objects and are separate from them. And so—which is to say, first—they come to a deep realization that all three realms of existence are only consciousness itself.
